x.description: array_like, 1 dimension, nonnegative ints Input array.
constraints: x must not contain negative ints

weights.description: array_like, optional Weights, array of the same shape as `x`.
constraints: weights must have the same shape as x

minlength.description: int, optional A minimum number of bins for the output array.

output.description: ------- ndarray of ints The result of binning the input array. The length of `out` is equal to ``np.amax(x)+1``.
